concepts.name: One page, in a format an ATS can read
Tailoring the resume to the job posting

questions.prompt: Which bullet follows Laszlo Bock's "Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]" formula?

choices.text: "Responsible for building AI agents with LangGraph and RAG for several different clients."
"Worked on a team that improved the customer support process at a growing startup."
"Cut ticket triage time 62% (40 to 15 min, 1,200 tickets/month) by building a LangGraph routing agent."
"Passionate AI engineer skilled in LangGraph, MCP, RAG, evals and prompt engineering."

questions.explanation: Bock's formula needs an accomplishment (X), a measure of it (Y) and how you did it (Z). The third bullet has all three: a verb and result, the numbers, and the system you built. "Responsible for" and "worked on a team" describe duties, not results, and a skills list has no accomplishment.

sources.title: My Personal Formula for a Winning Resume
sources.claim: Bock's formula is "Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y] by doing [Z]": an accomplishment, a measurement of it, and how you achieved it.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook asks for action words and quantified impact rather than lists of duties.

questions.prompt: In "Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]", what is Y?

choices.text: The number that measures the result
The tool or framework you used
The team you worked with
The dates of the project

questions.explanation: Y is the measurement: every example Bock gives has one, such as "12% ($1.2M)" or "30% ($500k)". Z is what you did to get there, which is where the tool or system goes. This lesson's rule "a verb, a system and a number" is the same idea.

sources.title: My Personal Formula for a Winning Resume
sources.claim: In Bock's formula Y is the measurement, and each of his example bullets carries a number such as 12% ($1.2M) or 30% ($500k).

questions.prompt: Rewrite "Built a RAG chatbot for a client" as a resume bullet with a verb, a system and a number, and explain what each part does.

model_answer.summary: For example: "Reduced support email volume 30% in two months by building a RAG chatbot over 2,000 help-centre articles." The verb and result say what you accomplished, the number measures it, and the system says how.
key_points: It starts with an action verb stating an accomplishment (X), not a duty
It includes a number that measures the result (Y)
It names the system you built and how (Z)
Every number is one you can explain and defend in an interview

questions.explanation: Bock's formula forces a result and a measure into every line, and the Tech Interview Handbook asks you to quantify impact and use action words. Interviewers will ask about the numbers, so use real ones.

sources.title: My Personal Formula for a Winning Resume
sources.claim: Bock's formula requires an accomplishment, a measure and the method in each resume bullet.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook advises using action words and quantifying the outcome of each achievement.

questions.prompt: According to the Tech Interview Handbook, which resume choice is most likely to cause trouble with an applicant tracking system (ATS)?

choices.text: A clean single-column PDF, written and exported from Google Docs or Word
A standard font such as Arial or Calibri at 10 pt or more
Using "|" as a simple divider between details on one line
A two-column design-tool layout with contact details in the page header

questions.explanation: The handbook says to create the resume in Word or Google Docs and submit it as a PDF, to use standard fonts at 10 pt or larger, and to avoid columns, headers, footers and graphic design tools. The other three options are exactly what it recommends.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook says to write the resume in Word or Google Docs, submit a PDF, use standard fonts at 10pt or more, and avoid headers, footers and graphic design tools; it allows "|" as a divider.

questions.prompt: A candidate with two years' experience has a two-page resume. What does the Tech Interview Handbook advise?

choices.text: Keep both pages, since more detail shows recruiters more of your work
Cut to one page, keeping the strongest items over many average ones
Shrink the font below 9 pt and the margins so it fits on one page
Move the extra detail into a second attached file for recruiters

questions.explanation: The handbook says to use only one page and not to list many average achievements just to fill space. Shrinking the font would break its advice to use at least 10 pt. Choosing the strongest bullets is the point.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook says to keep the resume to one page and to show fewer best achievements rather than many average ones, with a minimum 10pt font.

questions.prompt: A posting stresses "evals" and "MCP". Your resume says "testing LLM outputs" and "a tool-calling protocol" for the same work. What should you do?

choices.text: Use "evals" and "MCP" where they truthfully describe your work
Keep your own wording, since an ATS understands synonyms
Add a hidden list of the posting's keywords in white text at the end
Paste the full job description in small print at the bottom of the resume

questions.explanation: The Tech Interview Handbook says to analyse the job description, decide how important each skill is, and adjust how often its keywords appear. Using the posting's own words for work you really did helps both the ATS and the human reader. Hidden text and pasted descriptions are tricks, not tailoring.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook recommends analysing the job description for must-have skills and working its matching keywords into the resume.

questions.prompt: You have 15 minutes before applying. Explain how you would tailor your one-page resume to a specific AI agent engineer posting.

model_answer.summary: Rank the posting's requirements, then make the resume prove the top ones in the posting's own words, without breaking the one-page, ATS-friendly format.
key_points: Read the job description and rank its skills and experience by importance
Use the posting's terms and keywords where they truthfully describe your work
Choose and order bullets so the top requirements are proven first
Keep it to one page in the same ATS-friendly format

questions.explanation: This follows the handbook's tailoring advice. Tailoring changes emphasis and wording, never the facts. A tailored resume that stays one page usually means swapping bullets, not adding them.

sources.title: Practical guide to writing FAANG-ready software engineer resumes | Tech Interview Handbook
sources.claim: The handbook's tailoring advice is to analyse the job description, rank the required skills, and adjust the resume's keywords, while keeping a one-page ATS-friendly format.

questions.prompt: Why write your own LinkedIn headline instead of keeping the default?

choices.text: The headline is hidden from search, so it only matters on your profile page
The headline must match your job title exactly
The headline is only visible to your connections
It appears in search results, and by default it usually comes from your current position

questions.explanation: LinkedIn Help says the headline is the text below your name, that it is shown in search results, and that it is usually created when you add a current position. It can differ from your job title. A headline like "AI Agent Engineer · LangGraph · MCP · RAG · Evals" says what you do where recruiters search.

sources.title: Edit Your Headline | LinkedIn Help
sources.claim: LinkedIn Help says the headline sits below your name, is displayed in search results, is usually created when you add a current position, and can differ from your job title.

questions.prompt: You want to pin your four portfolio projects on LinkedIn. Which can go in the Featured section?

choices.text: Only posts you shared in Groups you belong to, not outside links
Outside links such as a repo or demo, plus posts, articles and media
Only articles you have published on LinkedIn, not links to outside sites
Nothing until you have 500 connections and a complete profile

questions.explanation: LinkedIn Help lists posts you created or re-shared, articles you published on LinkedIn, links to external websites, and uploaded media. It excludes posts from Groups and Events you are part of. You need at least two featured items to reorder them.

sources.title: Manage featured samples of your work on your LinkedIn profile
sources.claim: LinkedIn Help says Featured can hold posts you created or re-shared, articles you authored, links to external websites and uploaded media, but not posts from Groups or Events.

questions.prompt: Explain how you would set up your LinkedIn headline and Featured section so a recruiter searching for "AI agent engineer" finds you and can check your projects quickly.

model_answer.summary: Write a headline with the role and key skills, since it shows in search, and feature each project as a link or media item, ordered strongest first.
key_points: The headline appears in search results, so put the role and key skills in it
The headline can be different from your current job title
Add each project to Featured as an external link (repository or demo), a post, or uploaded media
Order the featured items strongest first (reordering needs at least two items)

questions.explanation: Both points come from LinkedIn Help. The Featured section is near the top of your profile, so a recruiter can open a project without scrolling through your history. Keep the projects the same as the ones on your resume.

sources.title: Edit Your Headline | LinkedIn Help
sources.claim: LinkedIn Help says the headline is shown in search results and can be separate from your current job title.

sources.title: Manage featured samples of your work on your LinkedIn profile
sources.claim: LinkedIn Help says Featured can hold external links, posts and media, and reordering requires at least two featured items.
